name: NORAMEGA
source:
The girl who suddenly appeared out of the sky is a self-proclaimed goddess...

Just when I thought this was like a story right out of a manga...

It came to like that she was just an apprentice who couldn't keep up in her class!

Since I saw her true form, she started living in my house, and what's worse, if I don't give her energy, her existence will cease to be!

NORAMEGA -Stray Goddess Picking Up- is the slapstick erotic comedy about what happens when you pick up a stray goddess.

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ039624.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
突然从天而降的女孩，是一位自称女神的女孩……

正当我以为这就像漫画里的故事时……

看来她只是一个跟不上班的学徒啊！

自从我看到了她的真身，她就开始住在我的房子里，更糟糕的是，如果我不给她能量，她的存在就会不复存在！

《NORAMEGA -流浪女神捡拾》是一部闹剧色情喜剧，讲述了当你捡到流浪女神时会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ039624.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
